4º de ESO · Inglés

Examen de prueba del 2º trimestre

Temas: Conditionals: zero, first, second and third · The passive voice · Reported speech · Relative clauses.

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________   Nota: ______

  1. «If you mix blue and yellow, you ___ green.»

  2. «If it ___ sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.»

  3. «If I ___ a million euros, I'd travel the world.»

  4. «If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.»

  5. «You can't go out ___ you finish your homework.»

  6. «If I ___ you, I'd tell the truth.»

  7. «I wish I ___ taller.» (presente)

  8. «If I had studied Law, I ___ a lawyer now.»

  9. «Take a jacket ___ it gets cold.»

  10. «You'll pass ___ you study.» (sin coma)

  11. «I'll call you ___ I get home.» (seguro que llego)

  12. «If I ___ the job, I'll move to Madrid.» (es posible)

  13. «___ you need help, do not hesitate to contact us.»

  14. «Hurry up, ___ we'll miss the train.»

  15. «I'll go ___ it rains.» (aunque llueva)

  16. «___ I known, I would have come.»

  17. «If I hadn't eaten so much, I ___ sick now.»

  18. «Take an umbrella ___ it rains.»

  19. «Suppose you ___ a famous singer. What would you do?»

  20. «I wish you ___ making that noise!» (queja)

  21. «If I ___ you, I'd apologise.»

  22. «I wish I ___ more free time.» (ahora)

  23. ¿Qué condicional habla de situaciones probables en el futuro?

  24. «If water reaches 0 °C, it ___.»

  25. «What would you do if you ___ a wallet?»

  26. «I wouldn't have got lost if I ___ a map.»

  27. «You can stay ___ you help with the cleaning.»

  28. «But ___ the rain, we would have won.»

  29. La pasiva se forma con…

  30. «The Mona Lisa ___ by Leonardo da Vinci.»

  31. Pasa a pasiva: «They speak English here.»

  32. «The new bridge ___ next year.»

  33. «I ___ my car repaired last week.» (lo hizo el taller)

  34. «The room ___ painted right now.»

  35. «She ___ a scholarship.» (le dieron)

  36. «Helmets ___ worn.» (obligatorio)

  37. «He is said ___ very rich.»

  38. «My bike got ___.»

  39. «The children were ___.» (cuidados)

  40. «I don't like ___ what to do.»

  41. «The door was opened ___ a key.»

  42. «The accident ___ at night.»

  43. «My car needs ___.»

  44. «Me robaron la bici» →

  45. «The bank ___ last night.»

  46. «Hamlet was written ___ Shakespeare.»

  47. «I want ___ to the party.»

  48. En un proceso, «First, the grapes ___.»

  49. «My wallet ___!» (acaban de robarlo)

  50. ¿Cuándo omitimos el agente (by…)?

  51. «Dinner ___ when we arrived.» (en progreso)

  52. «A new hospital ___ at the moment.»

  53. «This problem must be dealt ___ immediately.»

  54. «She ___ a prize at the ceremony.»

  55. «I ___ that the shop was closed.»

  56. «He is believed ___ abroad.»

  57. "I am happy," she said. → She said she ___ happy.

  58. "I will call you," he said. → He said he ___ call me.

  59. Elige la correcta:

  60. "Where do you live?" → She asked me where ___.

  61. "Don't be late!" → Mum told me ___ late.

  62. «I must go,» she said. → She said she ___ go.

  63. «Yesterday» en indirecto:

  64. «Don't touch it!» → He warned me ___ it.

  65. «Could you tell me where ___?»

  66. He ___ breaking the vase. (lo admitió)

  67. «I can help,» she said. → She said she ___ help.

  68. «You should rest,» the doctor said. → The doctor said I ___ rest.

  69. «Thank you!» said Ana. → Ana ___ me.

  70. «I didn't do it!» → He ___ doing it.

  71. She asked me ___.

  72. «Let's go out.» → He suggested ___ out.

  73. «Don't forget your keys,» she said. → She ___ me to take my keys.

  74. ___ the police, the thief escaped through a window.

  75. «I'll call you tomorrow,» she said (hace una semana). → She said she would call me ___.

  76. ¿Cuál es correcta?

  77. "I saw him yesterday." → She said she had seen him ___.

  78. "Are you coming?" → He asked me ___ I was coming.

  79. "I can swim." → He said he ___ swim.

  80. «Where is the station?» → Could you tell me where ___?

  81. «I'll pay you back,» he said. → He ___ to pay me back.

  82. «Be careful!» → She ___ me to be careful.

  83. «Have you finished?» → She asked if I ___.

  84. «I'm sorry I'm late,» he said. → He ___ for being late.

  85. «The woman ___ lives upstairs is a pilot.»

  86. «This is the café ___ we first met.»

  87. «He's the boy ___ mother is a famous singer.»

  88. ¿Qué frase es incorrecta?

  89. ¿En qué frase se puede omitir el relativo?

  90. «The house ___ I grew up in…»

  91. «She smiled, ___ made me happy.»

  92. «___ I want is some peace.»

  93. «The cars ___ in this factory are electric.»

  94. «The person to ___ I spoke…»

  95. «It's the best film ___ I've ever seen.»

  96. «___ I need is a long holiday.»

  97. «I have two sisters, both of ___ are doctors.»

  98. «Everything ___ he said was true.»

  99. «You can invite ___ you want.»

  100. «She bought three dresses, none of ___ fitted her.»

  101. «It's a place ___ you can buy medicines.»

  102. «The man ___ I was talking was my teacher.»

  103. «The girl ___ a blue dress is my cousin.»

  104. «He passed all his exams, ___ surprised everyone.»

  105. Las non-defining relative clauses van…

  106. «I'll never forget the day ___ I got my first bike.»

  107. «The phone ___ I bought last week is broken.»

  108. «The town ___ I was born is very small.»

  109. «My father, ___ is 50, plays football every week.»

  110. «The products ___ in this factory are exported.»

  111. «Do ___ you think is right.»

  112. ¿En qué frase NO se puede omitir el relativo?

Soluciones

  1. A) Verdad general: zero conditional.
  2. B) Después de if, present simple (nunca will).
  3. B) Situación imaginaria: second conditional (if + past).
  4. C) Pasado imposible: third conditional.
  5. B) Unless = if… not.
  6. A) If I were you…
  7. A) Wish + pasado.
  8. A) Mixto: pasado → presente.
  9. A) Por si acaso.
  10. A) Si va detrás, sin coma.
  11. A) Algo seguro: when.
  12. A) First conditional: posibilidad real.
  13. A) Inversión formal del first conditional.
  14. A) Otherwise = si no.
  15. A) Even if = incluso si.
  16. A) Inversión del third conditional.
  17. A) Mixto: pasado → presente.
  18. A) Precaución: in case.
  19. A) Suppose + pasado para una situación imaginaria.
  20. A) Wish + would: queja por un comportamiento.
  21. B) Consejo con second conditional: If I were you…
  22. B) Deseo sobre el presente: I wish + past.
  23. B) First conditional: if + present, will.
  24. A) Hecho científico: zero conditional.
  25. A) Pregunta hipotética: second conditional.
  26. A) Third conditional.
  27. A) Condición imprescindible.
  28. A) But for + sustantivo = de no ser por.
  29. B) Be en el tiempo correspondiente + participio.
  30. B) Pasiva en pasado: was + painted.
  31. A) Presente: is + spoken.
  32. A) Pasiva en futuro: will be + participio.
  33. A) Have something done: had my car repaired.
  34. A) Continuo: being.
  35. A) Persona como sujeto.
  36. A) Modal + be + participio.
  37. A) Sujeto + is said + to + infinitivo.
  38. A) Get + participio.
  39. A) La preposición se queda tras el verbo.
  40. A) Gerundio pasivo: being + participio.
  41. A) Instrumento: with.
  42. A) Happen no admite pasiva.
  43. A) Need + -ing = necesita ser lavado.
  44. B) La cosa robada es el sujeto.
  45. A) Rob + lugar o persona.
  46. A) Agente: by.
  47. A) Infinitivo pasivo.
  48. A) Proceso: present simple pasivo.
  49. A) Present perfect pasivo: has been + participio.
  50. A) «Rice is grown in Asia»: no importa quién.
  51. A) Past continuous pasivo: was being + participio.
  52. A) Acción en curso: present continuous pasivo.
  53. A) Deal with: la preposición se mantiene.
  54. A) Persona como sujeto con dos objetos.
  55. A) Me dijeron: I was told.
  56. A) Pasiva impersonal: be believed to + infinitivo.
  57. B) Backshift: am → was.
  58. B) Will → would.
  59. B) Tell lleva el destinatario directamente: told me.
  60. B) Orden afirmativo y sin do: where I lived.
  61. A) Órdenes negativas: tell + persona + not to + infinitivo.
  62. A) Must → had to.
  63. A) También the previous day.
  64. A) Warn + persona + not to.
  65. A) Sujeto + verbo.
  66. A) Admit + -ing.
  67. A) Can → could.
  68. A) Should no cambia.
  69. A) Resumir con el verbo thank.
  70. A) Deny + -ing.
  71. A) Orden de afirmación en la pregunta indirecta.
  72. A) Suggest + -ing.
  73. A) Remind someone to + infinitivo.
  74. A) According to = según.
  75. A) Contado tiempo después: the next day.
  76. B) Tell + persona.
  77. B) Yesterday → the day before.
  78. B) Preguntas de sí o no: if / whether.
  79. B) Can → could.
  80. A) Pregunta indirecta: sujeto + verbo.
  81. A) Promise + to + infinitivo.
  82. A) Warn someone to…
  83. A) Present perfect → past perfect.
  84. A) Apologise for + -ing.
  85. B) Persona: who (o that).
  86. A) Lugar: where.
  87. B) Posesión: whose.
  88. B) En non-defining (entre comas) no se usa that.
  89. A) Después viene otro sujeto (I): se puede quitar «that».
  90. A) Preposición al final con that / which o sin relativo.
  91. A) Which se refiere a toda la oración.
  92. A) What = lo que, sin antecedente.
  93. A) Relativa reducida pasiva.
  94. A) Tras preposición: whom.
  95. A) Tras superlativo: that.
  96. A) What = lo que, sin antecedente.
  97. A) Cantidad + of whom (personas).
  98. A) Tras everything: that.
  99. A) Whoever = cualquier persona que.
  100. A) Cosas: of which.
  101. A) Lugar + where.
  102. A) Preposición + whom (formal).
  103. A) Relativa reducida activa: -ing.
  104. A) Which para toda la idea, con coma.
  105. B) Añaden información extra entre comas.
  106. B) Tiempo: when.
  107. B) Cosa: which (o that, o nada).
  108. A) Lugar: where.
  109. A) Non-defining de persona: who.
  110. A) Relativa reducida pasiva: participio.
  111. A) Whatever = lo que sea que.
  112. B) Who es sujeto: no se puede omitir.
